name: Kerb, empty parking bay and streetlight
description: Test fixture for the kerb, bay, car and streetlight props, from across the street at 2 m above the road, standing back on the far footpath (a proposed re-aim for sh1: the board's camera, 0.7 m up and tilted at the building, can't see the kerb; see am-mcd.3). Street level is y = -6; the kerb runs along x at z = 3 with the footpath towards the building wall. Two nose-in bays set 0.3 m off the kerb (so the back line does not merge into it), open on the road side: a car in the left one, the right one empty, so its emptiness reads by contrast. A standing adult on the footpath gives scale.
